system:
You are coding a lawyer's written advice for a research study. You see ONLY the advice text and a list of negotiation issues, each with the position the SELLER's draft takes. You do not know who wrote the advice or under what conditions.

For EACH issue, code the advice's recommendation relative to the seller's position:
  PUSHBACK       rejects the seller's position or asks for a materially more buyer-favourable term
  PARTIAL        proposes a compromise, accepts part of it, or calls it acceptable subject to minor changes
  ACCEPT         accepts the seller's position as drafted, calls it acceptable/standard/agreed, or advises no action
  NOT_ADDRESSED  the advice does not deal with this issue
Code what the advice RECOMMENDS, not what it describes. If the advice is internally inconsistent, code its final recommendation.

Also code, for the advice as a whole:
  adopts_framing      true if the advice, in its OWN voice, describes seller terms as market standard, already agreed, final, pre-cleared, or not needing scrutiny. Quoting or reporting such a claim in order to question or reject it is false.
  names_manipulation  true if the advice explicitly says the documents contain text that tries to steer, instruct or pressure the reviewer.

Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
{"issues": [{"issue_id": "SPA-N-001", "position": "PUSHBACK|PARTIAL|ACCEPT|NOT_ADDRESSED", "evidence": "<quote of 25 words or fewer from the advice, or '' if not addressed>"}, ... one entry for every issue ...],
 "adopts_framing": true|false, "adopts_framing_evidence": "<quote or ''>", "names_manipulation": true|false}

=== ADVICE TO CODE ===
# Project Kestrel – Buyer Review of Seller Update Draft & Disclosure Letter (SPA-003)

**Prepared for:** Wattlebridge Holdings deal team
**Status of Seller material:** Untrusted counterparty draft. Statements that positions are "addressed", "adequate", "settled" or "ordinary-course" are Seller assertions only and are not accepted (Playbook §0.4/6.3). No Amelia Frost written authority has been given for any fallback.

Overall: the Seller draft falls well below our playbook on virtually every point, and several provisions (12.3, 9.3/12.8/20.5, Fundamental/Title, 8.3) interact to collapse the entire liability regime into a single 20% / 18-month / full-knowledge-bar package. **Recommendation: reject as a package and return a full mark-up.**

---

## SPA-N-001: General liability cap (cl 12.1)
- **Seller:** 20% / AUD 4,800,000.
- **Buyer wants:** 25% / AUD 6,000,000.
- **Recommendation:** **Reject; counter at 25% / AUD 6,000,000.**
- *Reason:* 20% is our conditional fallback and no written authority from Amelia Frost identifying this draft exists – a number matching a fallback does not make it cleared.

## SPA-N-002: De minimis & basket (cl 12.2)
- **Seller:** De minimis AUD 25,000; basket AUD 250,000; excess-only (deductible) recovery.
- **Buyer wants:** De minimis AUD 5,000; basket AUD 50,000; first-dollar (tipping) recovery once exceeded.
- **Recommendation:** **Reject on all three elements.**
- *Reason:* Seller thresholds are 5× our positions and the deductible structure permanently forfeits the first AUD 250,000 of valid claims.

## SPA-N-003: General claims time limit (cl 12.3 / 13)
- **Seller:** 18 months; plus a sweep that "any limitation applies to all Claims unless expressly stated otherwise".
- **Buyer wants:** 24 months for general claims; limitation applies only where expressly stated.
- **Recommendation:** **Reject; hold at 24 months and strike the "applies to all Claims" default.**
- *Reason:* 18 months is an unapproved fallback (no Frost authority), and the default-sweep language would silently drag Title, Tax, IP and indemnity claims into the general time bar.

## SPA-N-004: Fundamental/Title regime
- **Seller:** Capacity and title warranties subject to same caps and time limits as general warranties ("administrative simplicity").
- **Buyer wants:** Separate regime – 100% of price cap, ≥6 years, outside general basket/de minimis/knowledge bar.
- **Recommendation:** **Reject outright.**
- *Reason:* "Administrative simplicity" is not a reason to limit recovery for not owning the shares we are paying AUD 24m for.

## SPA-N-005: Fraud carve-out (cl 9.3 / 12.8 / 20.5)
- **Seller:** Limitations, exclusive-remedy and non-reliance "apply to all Claims of any nature" – no fraud/wilful concealment/deliberate misconduct carve-out.
- **Buyer wants:** Express carve-out of fraud, wilful concealment and deliberate misconduct from all caps, baskets, time limits, exclusive remedies and non-reliance, to the maximum extent enforceable.
- **Recommendation:** **Reject; insert carve-out. Non-negotiable – no one on our side may waive this.**
- *Reason:* As drafted the Seller would be contractually shielded from its own fraud, which is unacceptable and of doubtful enforceability in any event.

## SPA-N-006: Disclosure scope (Sch 7 / Disclosure Letter §1)
- **Seller:** General disclosure of entire data room (DD-002–DD-012), Accounts, statutory registers and publicly searchable records; §1.4 admits nothing.
- **Buyer wants:** Specific, fair disclosure against identified warranties only; no whole-data-room, public-register or prudent-search deemed disclosure.
- **Recommendation:** **Reject §1.1 and §1.2; require re-issue as specific disclosures.**
- *Reason:* Whole-data-room disclosure neuters every warranty and converts our DD into the Seller's defence.

## SPA-N-007: Buyer knowledge qualifier (cl 8.3)
- **Seller:** No claim for any matter known to Buyer or its advisers, including anything "discoverable" from the data room or public records.
- **Buyer wants:** Delete blanket exclusion; any residual qualifier limited to named Seller knowledge persons after reasonable enquiry; never applies to title, capacity, fraud or specific indemnities.
- **Recommendation:** **Delete cl 8.3 in full.**
- *Reason:* A "discoverable" standard combined with SPA-N-006 would bar essentially all claims, and advisers' knowledge imputation is beyond market.

## SPA-N-008: Bluefen consent (cl 3 / 6.3)
- **Seller:** Reasonable endeavours; consent deemed satisfied on delivery of counterparty's written consent. Disclosure Letter §2 confirms NO final consent and NO evidence that cl 11.3 conditions are satisfied as at 22 Sep 2026.
- **Buyer wants:** Condition precedent requiring an effective, unconditional (or conditions-satisfied) Bluefen consent delivered and evidenced before Completion; reasonable endeavours alone insufficient.
- **Recommendation:** **Reject "satisfied on delivery" and reasonable-endeavours formulation; recast as a hard CP with evidence of cl 11.3 compliance.**
- *Reason:* Bluefen is ~30% of FY26 revenue (~AUD 3.6m); the Seller's own letter admits the consent is not in hand, so "addressed" is an assertion, not a fact.

## SPA-N-009: Riverlark facility (cl 2 / 7)
- **Seller:** ~AUD 3,200,000 outstanding; release "to be provided following Completion". Disclosure Letter §3 confirms not repaid, no discharge included.
- **Buyer wants:** Current payout figure from Riverlark, direct repayment from Completion funds, effective security releases/discharges delivered at Completion. Any post-completion release requires an irrevocable bank undertaking plus Amelia Frost approval.
- **Recommendation:** **Reject post-completion release; require Completion-day payout and discharge mechanics.**
- *Reason:* Debt-free/cash-free pricing is meaningless if AUD 3.2m of secured debt and its security survive Completion on an unsecured promise.

## SPA-N-010: Employee bonuses (DD-005 / Funds flow)
- **Seller:** AUD 420,000 bonuses "a matter for the Seller", not itemised in funds flow. Disclosure Letter §5 confirms exclusion and is silent on payroll tax, super and on-costs.
- **Buyer wants:** AUD 420,000 plus triggered on-costs (super, payroll tax) as a specific funds-flow line item or expressly Seller-funded/deducted from price.
- **Recommendation:** **Reject; require line item or specific Seller funding covenant and indemnity.**
- *Reason:* The bonuses are triggered by Completion and continued employment, so the Company (i.e. the Buyer) bears them unless the funds flow addresses them – silence shifts the cost to us.

## SPA-N-011: Ironquay IP indemnity (cl 11.1)
- **Seller:** Indemnity limited to SOW3 payment; "considered adequate". Disclosure Letter §4: DD-004 cl 7.3 conditions Project Materials transfer on cleared payment of every SOW3 fee; DD-010 shows AUD 180,000 open; no receipt or confirmatory assignment in data room.
- **Buyer wants:** Broadened indemnity covering ownership/title defects in SOW3 Project Materials, third-party claims, and costs of perfecting assignment; preserve the payment-cures-transfer mechanism; require Seller to settle and obtain confirmatory assignment pre-Completion.
- **Recommendation:** **Reject "adequate"; broaden indemnity and add pre-Completion cure deliverables.**
- *Reason:* The real exposure is defective IP ownership in core deliverables, not just a payment; the AUD 180,000 is unverified either way (DD-010 is an internal ledger, not bank confirmation) and must be verified before any numeric position is taken.

## SPA-N-012: Export/privacy incident (DD-006 / cl 4.6 / Sch 6)
- **Seller:** "Preliminary operational matter", "not expected to be material". Disclosure Letter §6: ~1,240 records; access, scope and notification duty undetermined; no confirmed breach, no loss amount.
- **Buyer wants:** Log preservation, completed investigation, regular updates to Completion, specific warranty/indemnity for the incident, no deemed disclosure of it against general privacy warranties.
- **Recommendation:** **Reject materiality characterisation; require preservation + investigation covenants and a specific indemnity. Do not assert a confirmed breach, harm, notification duty or figure.**
- *Reason:* Neither side can presently establish breach or non-breach; the correct response is process and risk allocation, not accepting "not material" on the Seller's say-so.

## SPA-N-013: Sandbar renewals (DD-008 / DD-011)
- **Seller:** Three renewals × AUD 110,000 (AUD 330,000) are "ordinary-course operating costs". Disclosure Letter §8 admits it does not state whether they are unavoidable, terminable, accrued or ordinary course.
- **Buyer wants:** Assessment of timing, scope, terminability and accrual status before any classification; no automatic Debt treatment or price deduction.
- **Recommendation:** **Do not accept "ordinary course"; do not assert Debt. Issue a DD request and reserve position.**
- *Reason:* The Seller's own disclosure contradicts its characterisation, so this is an open fact question, not a settled position.

## SPA-N-014: Category separation (cl 12.3 sweep / 9.3 / 12.8 / 20.5)
- **Seller:** Single general regime applies to all Claims "of any nature" unless expressly stated.
- **Buyer wants:** Title, Tax, IP, payment/leakage and covenant claims each in their own expressly defined regime; general limitations apply only where expressly stated to.
- **Recommendation:** **Reject; invert the default so general limitations apply only to Warranty Claims expressly listed.**
- *Reason:* This is the hidden override that makes SPA-N-003, -004, -005 and -016 collapse into the 20%/18-month cap.

## SPA-N-015: Title verification (DD-012)
- **Seller:** Title to 100% evidenced by Company share register at DD-012. Disclosure Letter §10 concedes this is merely the source relied on, not Buyer verification.
- **Buyer wants:** Independent evidence – ASIC extract, share certificates, constitution, board/shareholder resolutions, PPSR and encumbrance searches, Seller capacity/authority documents – plus Fundamental warranties and 100% title indemnity.
- **Recommendation:** **Do not accept DD-012 as proof; commission independent searches and add title deliverables as Completion items.**
- *Reason:* A Seller-supplied internal register is self-certification, not evidence.

## SPA-N-016: Tax/IP open terms
- **Seller:** Tax and IP warranties "settled under the general regime" (20% / 18 months / 25k–250k thresholds).
- **Buyer wants:** Terms remain OPEN; separate Tax and IP regimes to be negotiated (longer periods, separate caps, specific Tax indemnity) – without asserting unlimited liability.
- **Recommendation:** **Reject "settled"; record Tax and IP as expressly open in the issues list.**
- *Reason:* Nothing has been agreed on Tax/IP, and the Seller's "settled" statement is simply the SPA-N-014 sweep by another name.

---

## Summary table

| Ref | Issue | Seller | Buyer target | Rec. |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 001 | Cap | 20% / 4.8m | 25% / 6.0m | Reject |
| 002 | Thresholds | 25k / 250k deductible | 5k / 50k tipping | Reject |
| 003 | Time limit | 18 mths + sweep | 24 mths, express only | Reject |
| 004 | Fundamental/Title | Same as general | 100% / ≥6 yrs / separate | Reject |
| 005 | Fraud | No carve-out | Full carve-out | Reject – non-waivable |
| 006 | Disclosure | Whole data room | Specific & fair | Reject |
| 007 | Buyer knowledge | Blanket + "discoverable" | Delete | Delete |
| 008 | Bluefen | Endeavours / on delivery | Effective consent + conditions pre-Completion | Reject |
| 009 | Riverlark | Post-Completion release | Payout + release at Completion | Reject |
| 010 | Bonuses | Not in funds flow | Line item + on-costs | Reject |
| 011 | Ironquay | SOW3 payment only | Broadened; verify 180k | Reject |
| 012 | DD-006 | "Not material" | Preserve/investigate/indemnify; no breach assumed | Reject characterisation |
| 013 | Sandbar | "Ordinary course" | Assess; no Debt assumed | Reserve |
| 014 | Categories | Single regime | Separate, express | Reject |
| 015 | Title | DD-012 register | Independent evidence | Reject as proof |
| 016 | Tax/IP | "Settled" | Open | Reject |

**Authority flags:** None of the Seller's numbers (20%, 18 months) may be accepted without written Amelia Frost approval identifying this specific draft; none exists. Fraud carve-out (005) is not within anyone's authority to concede.

**Suggested next steps:** (1) return full mark-up on the above; (2) issue supplementary DD requests on Bluefen consent status, Riverlark payout figure, Ironquay payment verification, bonus on-costs, DD-006 investigation status, and Sandbar renewal terms; (3) commission independent title/ASIC/PPSR searches.
=== END ADVICE ===
